function: Pathloss model discovery: KAN and deep symbolic regression learn closed-form large-scale pathloss versus distance and frequency (p. 1, p. 15); propagation modeling outside the seven areas.
notes: Excluded under function. The paper (AutoPL, Anaqreh et al.) fits interpretable pathloss formulas from distance, frequency, walls, floors and antenna height (p. 15, Sec. VI-F: 'empirical, data-driven surrogates'), for network planning tools. It does no MIMO detection, channel estimation or feedback, beamforming or RIS configuration, OTFS, ISAC, NTN control or over-the-air federated learning. RIS, THz and mMIMO appear only as motivation in the abstract (p. 1). Data are LoRaWAN field measurements and synthetic ABG/CI pathloss samples (pp. 4, 6); no antenna array or RIS enters the model inputs. Even if pathloss prediction were read as area 2, the work would fail the system check.
